actors.name: catalog-feed-normalizer
actors.title: Shopify Catalog Feed Normalizer
actors.seo_short_description: Convert messy supplier CSV feeds into RFC 4180 Shopify product import CSVs with automatic multi-variant grouping and formula protection.
actors.seo_long_description: Eliminate hours of manual spreadsheet repair. Ingests messy, inconsistent CSVs and raw product feeds from vendors, automatically maps columns, groups multi-variant SKUs under canonical handles, normalizes prices to two decimals, and sanitizes dangerous spreadsheet formula triggers (=, +, -, @) to guarantee 100% rejection-free Shopify catalog imports.

tools_exposed.name: catalog_feed_normalizer
tools_exposed.description: Normalizes supplier catalog CSV data into standardized Shopify-compatible product records.

tools_exposed.name: website_health_checker
